name: Elasticsearch - Overview
description: The Elasticsearch - Overview dashboard provides the health of Elasticsearch clusters, shards analysis, resource utilization of Elasticsearch host & clusters,  search and indexing performance.
title: Elasticsearch - Overview

queries.queryString: sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.shards state=active_primary | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.time operation=index aggregation=total  | avg by db.node.name, db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.completed operation=query aggregation=total db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | rate  | avg by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.completed operation=fetch aggregation=total db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | rate | avg by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.time operation=refresh aggregation=total db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.time operation=flush aggregation=total  db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.health   db.node.name={{db.node.name}}  status=green | filter latest > 0 |  min by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.health   db.node.name={{db.node.name}}  status=yellow | filter latest>0  | min by db.node.name | eval _value * 2

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.health   db.node.name={{db.node.name}}  status=red | filter latest>0 | min by db.node.name | eval _value * 3

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.index.operations.time aggregation=primary_shards operation=index  db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.available  db.node.name={{db.node.name}}  | sum by db.node.name, db.node.name

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.node.fs.disk.total db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by db.node.name, db.node.name
(1-(#A/#B))*100 along db.node.name | sum by db.node.name
sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.node.open_files  db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| timeslice 1h
| count by es_component, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column es_component

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.shards state=active db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric
sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.nodes db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN"
| count by es_component

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.shards state=unassigned  db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "ERROR" or level = "FATAL"
| count by es_component

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.node.operations.completed operation=index db.node.name={{db.node.name}} |  rate increasing

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN" and message matches "*took_millis*"
| timeslice 1 h
| count by _timeslice

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.shards state=unassigned_delayed db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} metric=elasticsearch.cluster.shards state=relocating db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | sum by metric

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| timeslice 1h
| count by level, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column level

sumo.datasource=elasticsearch db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}}  deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} db.node.name={{db.node.name}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as es_component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN" and message matches "*took_millis*"
| count
